name: zanker-scenario-engine
description: Build deterministic mock states for loading, error, empty, overflow and user permissions.

workflow.instruction: List all distinct user-visible states and relevant transitions.
Create JSON array of id/label/props fixtures using synthetic data.
Supply wrapper/provider mocks for network, auth, locale and feature flags when needed.
Run previews at mobile and desktop sizes and check recovery interactions.

fallback: Document unavailable states and recommend integrated tests.
